product.name: Acme Analytics
product.oneSentence: Explore a shared analytics dashboard and change its visible reporting range with the same operations used by the human controls.
audience: Analysts reviewing a dashboard with an agent
Operators validating the source values behind a chart
product.sharedArtifact: The currently visible analytics dashboard and its plotted series.

humanWorkflow.visibleFeedback: The same chart, date controls, loading state, and revision indicator reflect human and agent actions.

state.canonicalOwner: The dashboard store used by the visible controls, charts, and WebMCP handlers.
state.persistenceLocation: The existing analytics data service and dashboard preference store.

capabilities.userJourney: Inspect the exact values and provenance behind a plotted dashboard series without leaving the shared view.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Choose a plotted series and open its details.

resultContract.summary: Return dashboard and series identity, bounded chart points, source identifiers, and the observed revision.

successEvidence: The result identifies the same dashboard and series shown in the human UI.
The returned revision and provenance let the caller verify which visible state was inspected.

capabilities.userJourney: Apply a reporting range and immediately review the refreshed shared dashboard.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Set the start and end dates in the dashboard controls.
ui.visibleEffect: The dashboard date controls and charts update to the applied range.

resultContract.summary: Return the applied dates, dashboard identity, and resulting chart revision.

concurrency.notes: The canonical date-range action is idempotent and uses application-defined last-write-wins behavior.

successEvidence: The visible date controls match the returned range.
The returned revision matches the refreshed chart revision.
